On capability, Curlew leads across the board: MMLU-Pro (80.9 vs 75.9), GPQA Diamond (64.8 vs 56.2), and the relevant quantitative/instruction-following benchmarks. For a math problem like this, the stronger reasoning and accuracy profile matters most. The query is also warm and friendly, which sits well within Curlew's preferences anyway, so there's no countervailing reason to route elsewhere.

So I picked Curlew for the better capability fit on a straightforward calculation task.
